description_en: Sets the resource monitoring scope for the current account
description_zh: 设置当前账号的资源监控范围
name: StartConfigurationRecorder

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to upgrade to the Enterprise Edition of Cloud Config. Valid values:

true

false (default)

The Enterprise Edition of Cloud Config is upgraded to account groups. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213433.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否升级企业版配置审计。取值：
true
false（默认值）

企业版配置审计升级为账号组。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213433.html
parameters.name: enterprise_edition

AccountId.description_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

This parameter is returned only when a standard account calls this operation
AccountId.description_zh:
阿里云账号ID。

仅当普通账号调用该接口时，返回该参数

ConfigurationRecorderStatus.description_en:
The status of resource monitoring. Valid values:

REGISTRABLE: The resource monitoring is not enabled.

BUILDING: The resource monitoring is being enabled.

REGISTERED: The resource monitoring is enabled.

REBUILDING: The resource monitoring is being re-enabled
ConfigurationRecorderStatus.description_zh:
资源监控状态。取值：
REGISTRABLE：未注册。
BUILDING：构建中。
REGISTERED：已注册。
REBUILDING：重新构建中

OrganizationEnableStatus.description_en:
The status of the upgrade to the Enterprise Edition of Cloud Config. Valid values:

REGISTRABLE: The service is not upgraded.

BUILDING: The service is being upgraded.

REGISTERED: The service is upgraded
OrganizationEnableStatus.description_zh:
企业版配置审计升级状态。取值：
REGISTRABLE：未升级。
BUILDING：升级中。
REGISTERED：已升级

OrganizationMasterId.description_en:
The ID of the management account.

This parameter is returned only when a management account calls this operation
OrganizationMasterId.description_zh:
企业管理账号ID。

仅当企业管理账号调用该接口时，返回该参数

items.description_en:
The list of resource types.

By default, Cloud Config returns all resource types. The example response shows only the `ACS::ECS::Instance` and `ACS::ECS::NetworkInterface` resource types
items.description_zh:
资源类型列表。

配置审计默认返回全部资源类型，返回示例仅以资源类型`ACS::ECS::Instance`和`ACS::ECS::NetworkInterface`为例进行展示
